summary: Iteration 4 — Full regression of NEW Omniparse OCR upgrade (offline Tesseract deu+eng) + Personalausweis auto-detection on top of the existing 9-format MarkItDown matrix. Fixed iter4-authored assertion in test_regression_formats.py (S3 sync correlationId lives under result, not top-level). Added 5 NEW backend tests for OCR/ID flows. Backend: 27/27 pytest cases pass (10 in test_extraction_api.py + 17 in test_regression_formats.py). Frontend Playwright: page loads, health-badge GREEN, ready-badge GREEN, JWT auto-minted (len=240, 2 dots). Image upload (german_doc.jpg) -> 200, ocr-badge='OCR tesseract:deu+eng' rendered, model-badge='Mock LLM', correlation-id='ui-...', structured JSON shows German fields (Steuer Identifikationsnummer, Meldebescheinigung, Mietvertrag, München, Bayern), Markdown tab shows OCR text with umlauts preserved. S3 sync -> 200, no ocr-badge (correct, ocrUsed=false). Async mode + .docx upload -> 202 PENDING -> COMPLETED with structured result rendered. RFC 7807 problem+json verified for 401/403/400/404/422. Blank PDF still 422 with 'no extractable text'; scanned image-only PDF now succeeds via OCR fallback (ocrUsed=true). German umlauts ä ö ü ß round-trip correctly through JSON transport.

backend: test_sync_format_matrix_returns_200_structured x9 (PDF text, DOCX, PPTX, XLSX, TXT, MD, HTML, CSV, JSON) -> all 200, mock=true, structured(documentType/title/sections/fields/summary), markdownChars>0
NEW test_sync_ocr_image_jpeg_german -> 200, result.ocrUsed=true, ocrEngine contains 'tesseract'+'deu'+'eng', markdownChars>0, structured present
NEW test_sync_ocr_personalausweis_detection -> structured.documentType=='Personalausweis' with surname/givenNames/dateOfBirth populated, ocrUsed=true
NEW test_sync_scanned_pdf_ocr_fallback -> 200 with ocrUsed=true via PyMuPDF rasterize + Tesseract (previously 500/422)
NEW test_sync_german_chars_preserved -> ä ö ü ß all present in response markdown
NEW test_async_image_ocr_completes -> 202 PENDING -> COMPLETED with result.ocrUsed=true
frontend: page loads, health-badge GREEN, ready-badge GREEN
source-tab-upload + file-input set to /tmp/german_doc.jpg + sync extract -> 200, json-output rendered with documentType/title/sections/fields/summary
markdown-output renders OCR'd German text (Kontoetatinung, Meldebescheinigung, Steuer Identifikationsnummer, Mietvertrag, München, Bayern)
source-tab-s3 + sync -> 200 json-output with ACME invoice fields; ocr-badge ABSENT (ocrUsed=false) — correct
mode-async + upload s.docx + extract -> 202 PENDING -> COMPLETED in poll loop; json-output renders structured result
All RFC 7807 error paths covered by backend pytest

critical_code_review_comments: OCRService correctly registers pillow_heif before any Image.open; verified IMAGE_EXTS includes .heic/.heif. Recommend smoke-testing a HEIC fixture in a future iteration (no .heic fixture currently in /tmp).

ExtractionPipeline._convert_path routes images -> OCR and PDFs -> text-layer-first-then-OCR-fallback. The OCR fallback on PDFs uses PyMuPDF rasterize per page; consider capping page count for very large scanned PDFs (latency/memory) — currently no max-pages guard observed.

LLMExtractionService._mock_extract auto-detects Personalausweis via _ID_MARKERS — keyword match works on synthetic fixtures. For production, consider also matching on MRZ patterns (IDD<<...) for stronger detection.

OpenAICompatibleProvider.supports_vision=True path (OCR_VISION=true) was NOT exercised here because no hosted vision model is configured (OCR_VISION=false in env). Functional but unverified end-to-end.

Carryovers still valid: build_provider() silent mock fallback (consider STRICT_PROVIDER env); LLMExtractionService._attempt retries 4xx auth errors (should be non-retryable); CORS allow_origins='*' with allow_credentials=True; mock _note field should be debug-gated for prod.
Sync file cap 5MB->413 not exercised in this run (no >5MB fixture); main agent's hand-off says it's enforced.
updated_files: /app/backend/tests/test_regression_formats.py (fixed S3 correlationId assertion to read from payload.result; appended 5 OCR/ID/async-OCR tests)
test_credentials: Mock OIDC mint via POST /api/v1/auth/token {sub, roles:['extractor','admin']}; viewer role used for 403 path. No LLM keys -> deterministic mock fallback (model='mock'). Tesseract OCR is REAL/offline (deu+eng).
seed_data_creation: Reused pre-staged /tmp fixtures: text.pdf, blank.pdf, s.{docx,pptx,xlsx,txt,md,html,csv,json}, german_doc.jpg, ausweis.png, scanned.pdf. No new files created.
context_for_next_testing_agent: Run all backend tests: REACT_APP_BACKEND_URL=<url> pytest /app/backend/tests/ -v --junitxml=/app/test_reports/pytest/pytest_results.xml. The Omniparse OCR upgrade is end-to-end working: Tesseract deu+eng OCRs images and scanned PDFs; Personalausweis auto-detection populates documentType+surname+givenNames+dateOfBirth; ocr-badge surfaces in UI with engine string. Open verification gaps: (1) OCR_VISION=true path (no hosted vision provider here), (2) HEIC fixture (pillow-heif registered but no .heic file in /tmp), (3) >5MB 413 file-cap. Backend extraction pipeline unchanged contract for the 9 text formats — no regression.
rca of the issue: Carryover from iter4: the freshly-authored test_regression_formats.py used payload.get('correlationId') for the S3 sync test, but for SYNC responses correlationId is nested under payload['result']. Fixed in this iteration. All other assertions (top-level for problem+json error bodies, result-nested for success bodies) match the real API contract observed via curl and Playwright.
